title: Microsoft Teams: new sharing panel in meetings
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap target from Microsoft's announced rollout windows and user-level opt-out. The documented screen-sharing control, Teams licence requirement and default state are supported; targeted searches found no separate administrative switch or panel-specific licensing requirement.

claims.claim: The control is in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Content sharing > Screen sharing mode.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select the policy that you want to edit.
3. Go to the Content sharing section.
4. Select the settings you want to use. These settings are described in the Screen sharing mode, PowerPoint Live, Whiteboard, Live share, and Shared notes sections

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -ScreenSharingMode <mode> changes the screen sharing mode of the identified meeting policy.
claims.quote:
### -ScreenSharingMode

Determines the mode in which a user can share a screen in calls or meetings. Set this to SingleApplication to allow the user to share an application at a given point in time. Set this to EntireScreen to allow the user to share anything on their screens.
